title: Analysis code and frozen provenance for: Cell-state mixture and detection depth can change what a transferred single-cell signature reports
description:
Complete analysis code, frozen analysis plans, archived intermediate results, figure-generation scripts with their machine-readable source tables, and a tested reference implementation of the four-term patient-weighted decomposition, for the accompanying manuscript.

The study is a secondary analysis of previously published, publicly available data. Primary datasets are not redistributed here; they are available from GEO (GSE285325, GSE290679), Zenodo record 7924238, the Single Cell Portal (SCP548) and CELLxGENE, as described in README.md.
